clause: Raster tonal-diagnostics feedback surface: histogram, color sampler, eyedropper, info readout [STU-RAS-049]

scope.summary: Implement the raster tonal-diagnostics feedback surface the adjustment/levels/curves/exposure/mode loops depend on: a live histogram (per-composite and per-channel, with clip warnings); a persistent multi-point color sampler (>=4 sample points reading live values); an eyedropper sampling into the active swatch with sample-size and sample-layer scopes; and an info/readout of pixel values, position, and dimensions under the pointer or over a selection. All MUST be inspectable state for a no-context model per STU-RAS-001; full color-metering authority is shared with 14.8 and 14.16 (consume, do not fork).
acceptance_criteria: Live per-composite/per-channel histogram with clip warnings
proof_targets: live histogram + multi-point sampler runtime + inspectable-state query
expected_tests: live: histogram updates per-composite and per-channel with clip warnings as pixels change; place 4 color-sampler points reading live values; eyedropper samples into the active swatch honoring sample-size/layer scope
test: histogram + sampler + info readout are queryable as inspectable state (no-context)
acceptance_criteria_original: live per-composite/per-channel histogram with clip warnings
persistent >=4-point color sampler + scoped eyedropper + info readout, all inspectable

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Histogram, color sampler & info

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-049]** Studio MUST provide the raster tonal-diagnostics feedback surface: a live histogram (per-composite and per-channel, with clip warnings), a persistent multi-point colour sampler, an eyedropper sampling into the active swatch with sample-size and sample-layer scopes, and an info/readout of pixel values, position and dimensions under the pointer or over a selection.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
